pages: Oh my... it really does look nice.

but they seem kind of stuck-up...

Myself...
I think a lovely woman is charming wherever she's from.

the Yamato Nadeshiko of all Yamato Nadeshiko...

Maybe so...
Maybe the day when fighting ends will never come...
...That's not true!
Maybe not right now, but someday... for sure...
Hmph... No one can know that.

That's not so!
Once people learn what truly matters...
the conflict among them should disappear.

Please don't be sad...
If we rid the world of evil bit by bit,

Hahaha!

Delicious!
...Um... hey?

Fine sake...

No...

quite different from the customers I've had before...

please... come talk with me again.
